definition.simple: Cutting and gathering mature crops from the field.
definition.academic: Harvesting is the process of gathering a ripe crop from the fields. It involves cutting the mature crop close to the ground or pulling it out.

examples: Plucking ripe apples from a tree

common_misconceptions: Harvesting means the crop is ready to eat instantly (it often needs threshing/winnowing first).
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student what they do when fruits are fully ripe on a tree. That act of picking is also harvesting!
